cvFields.heading: CV Details
cvFields.intro: A few extra details that make your CV ready for job applications. All optional — leave anything blank.
cvFields.summaryHint: 2–3 lines a hiring manager reads first. Lead with years of experience and your strongest result.
cvFields.summaryPlaceholder: Senior analyst with 8+ years across banking and consulting, known for turning data into decisions that moved KWD 12M in budget.
cvFields.languagesHint: Add the languages you work in. Arabic and English are pre-filled — adjust your level or remove them.
cvFields.nationalityHint: Optional. Leave blank if you prefer not to share.
cvFields.referencesHint: Add references, or leave empty — your CV will simply show "Available on request".
cvFields.referencesEmptyNote: No references added. Your CV will show "Available on request".

developer.aboutIntro: Your developer identity. This drives the hero — your name in giant gradient type, your role, and your pitch. Empty fields are auto-hidden.
developer.fullNameHint: Shown large in the hero, in gradient display type
developer.title: Role / Title
developer.subtitle: Subtitle
developer.subtitleHint: Shown next to your title, e.g. "Full-Stack Engineer · Creative Technologist"
developer.valuePropositionPlaceholder: I build fast, interactive web products — from real-time systems to 3D interfaces — and care about the polish that makes software feel alive.
developer.valuePropositionHint: The one-paragraph pitch under your name in the hero. 1–2 sentences.
developer.githubHint: Shown as a button in the hero and footer
developer.resumeUrlHint: Link to your resume PDF. Shows as a prominent "Resume" button in the hero.
developer.metricsHint: The animated counters in your hero. Add 2–4 punchy numbers — years shipping, projects delivered, users reached.
developer.stackIntro: Pick the tools you use. They render as the keycap grid and power the live, clickable 3D keyboard — names like React, Node.js, and Docker light up real keys.
developer.stackKeyboardHint: Tip: the well-known tools below map to real keys on the floating 3D keyboard. Don't see one? Add it under "Add other".
developer.stackItemsHint: Comma-separated. e.g. React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind
developer.stackEmptyHint: Tap the tools you use — or add your own.
developer.trackballHint: The word engraved on the keyboard's trackball — your name, or any word. Defaults to your first name.
developer.bulkHint: Separate with commas or new lines. We'll match each to a keycap.
developer.experienceIntro: Your work history as a timeline. Most recent first — focus on what you shipped and the impact.
developer.experiencePowerWords: Power verbs: Built, Shipped, Architected, Scaled, Reduced, Automated, Migrated, Led, Optimized
developer.expDescriptionPlaceholder: Lead engineer on a real-time collaboration product used by design teams.
developer.expHighlightsPlaceholder:
Cut p95 page load by 47% with streaming SSR and an edge cache
Architected an async job pipeline processing 1k+ tasks/day
Mentored four engineers and introduced trunk-based delivery
developer.expHighlightsHint: Start each line with a verb. Add numbers.
developer.credentialsIntro: Optional. Degrees and certifications appear in the two-column "extras" section.
developer.colorsHint: Pick a preset or tune individual colors. The template is space-dark by default.

general.basicsIntro: Fill in your core professional identity. The published portfolio will have an auto-translate button for Arabic.
general.fullNameHint: As it appears on your official documents
general.cvFilledSuccess: CV filled! Review each step and edit as needed.
general.fillCvButton: Fill my entire CV with AI
general.aiCtaBody: Create a free account to let AI write your summary and fill your CV. Your draft is saved.
general.subtitleHint: A one-liner that captures your professional brand
subtitleExamples: Transforming complex data into actionable insights
Building scalable solutions for enterprise challenges
general.summaryPlaceholder: Write 2-3 sentences about your expertise and career highlights...
general.summaryHint: Focus on achievements and impact, not just job duties.
summaryTips: Start with your years of experience and core expertise
Use strong verbs: led, delivered, transformed, optimized

summaryTemplates.label: Finance
summaryTemplates.text: Results-driven financial analyst with [X]+ years of experience in corporate finance, investment analysis, and risk management. Proven track record of delivering data-driven insights that have influenced over $[X] in strategic decisions.

summaryTemplates.label: Tech
summaryTemplates.text: Full-stack engineer with [X]+ years building scalable applications. Led teams of [X] and delivered solutions serving [X]+ users.

summaryTemplates.label: General
summaryTemplates.text: Accomplished professional with [X]+ years of experience in [field]. Known for [key strength] and delivering measurable results including [achievement].

general.valuePropPlaceholder: What unique value do you bring to employers?
general.valuePropHint: Your elevator pitch — why should they hire YOU?
valuePropTips: Answer: What problem do you solve better than anyone?
Include your unique combination of skills
general.aiLimitReached: Daily AI limit reached — try again tomorrow.
general.expIntro: Most recent first. Focus on results and impact.
general.expPowerWordsList: Led, Delivered, Reduced, Increased, Automated, Designed, Launched, Optimized, Managed, Generated
roleDescTips: Describe scope: team size, budget, departments
general.highlightsPlaceholder:
Reduced operational costs by 18%
Led cross-functional team of 6 analysts
Delivered $1.2B risk framework ahead of schedule
general.highlightsHint: Start each line with a power verb. Add numbers.
highlightsTips: Formula: [Action verb] + [what you did] + [result with numbers]
Bad: 'Responsible for reports' → Good: 'Delivered 50+ monthly reports reducing decision time by 30%'
general.achIntro: Showcase 1-3 major impact stories. The first one marked as "Featured" gets a larger card.
general.achStarText: Situation (context) → Task (what was needed) → Action (what you did) → Result (quantified outcome). Add KPIs and tools used for maximum impact.
general.achSituationPlaceholder: Corporate Banking Division managing $1.2B across 200+ institutional clients...
general.achSituationHint: Describe the challenge or context (anonymize if needed)
achSituationTips: Set the scene: what was the problem or opportunity?
Include scale: team size, budget, scope
general.achToolsPlaceholder: Python, Bloomberg, Power BI, SQL, Risk Analytics
general.skillsIntro: Group skills by category (e.g., Technical, Leadership).
general.endIntro: Testimonials build trust. Professional memberships show commitment.
general.endAccordionSubtitle: Quotes from colleagues or supervisors who can vouch for your work.
general.quotePlaceholder: Sarah's analytical rigor and attention to detail consistently deliver exceptional results...
quoteTips: Ask your reference to focus on specific skills or projects
Keep it 2-3 sentences — concise and specific beats long and vague

quoteTemplates.label: Skills-focused
quoteTemplates.text: [Name]'s expertise in [skill] is exceptional. Their ability to [specific action] has consistently delivered [measurable result] for our team.

quoteTemplates.label: Leadership
quoteTemplates.text: Working with [Name] has been outstanding. They led [project/initiative] with remarkable [quality], delivering results that exceeded expectations by [metric].

general.affAccordionSubtitle: Memberships in professional bodies show industry commitment.
general.devAccordionSubtitle: Recent courses show you stay current in your field.
general.colorSchemeIntro: Pick a preset or customize individual colors.
general.sectionVisibilityHint: Uncheck sections you want to hide.
general.aiLockedHint: AI Fill: add your full name and professional title above to unlock the AI assistant.
general.aiUnavailableHint: The AI assistant is temporarily unavailable — you can fill everything manually.

cv.signInToUnlock: Sign in to unlock — your draft is saved
cv.aiLimitReached: Daily AI limit reached — try again tomorrow.
cv.aiUnavailable: AI writing is temporarily unavailable — write your summary manually, or try again later.

engineer.basicsIntro: Your engineering identity. The published portfolio auto-hides empty fields.
engineer.basicsFullNameHint: As it appears on your professional documents
engineer.basicsSubtitlePlaceholder: Power systems and renewable energy integration
engineer.basicsSubtitleHint: A one-liner about your engineering focus area
basicsSubtitleExamples: Power systems and renewable energy integration
Structural design for high-rise and industrial facilities
Process optimization in oil & gas downstream operations
engineer.basicsGithubHint: For code repos, simulations, or technical work
engineer.basicsResumeUrlHint: Link to your resume PDF. Shows as a prominent 'Resume' button on the portfolio (like greglagana.com). Upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, or your own site.
engineer.basicsBioPlaceholder: Write 2-3 sentences about your engineering background and expertise...
engineer.basicsBioHint: Describe your technical focus, industries you've worked in, and what drives you.
basicsBioWritingTips: Lead with your discipline and years of experience
Name the industries you've worked in (oil & gas, construction, power, etc.)
Mention specific technical domains (SCADA, FEA, PLC, CFD, etc.)
Keep it factual — let your projects speak for impact

basicsBioTemplates.label: Experienced
basicsBioTemplates.text: [Discipline] engineer with [X]+ years of experience in [industry]. Specialized in [technical domain], with hands-on project delivery spanning [scope]. Committed to engineering excellence and practical problem-solving.

basicsBioTemplates.label: Fresh Graduate
basicsBioTemplates.text: Recent [degree] graduate from [university] with strong foundations in [technical areas]. Completed [X] academic and personal projects including [notable project]. Eager to apply analytical skills to real-world engineering challenges.

engineer.basicsObjectivePlaceholder: What kind of engineering work are you seeking?
engineer.basicsObjectiveHint: Optional — shown as a highlighted quote on your portfolio
basicsObjectiveWritingTips: State the type of role or projects you're targeting
Mention what you bring: specific skills, certifications, domain knowledge
engineer.projIntro: Showcase your engineering work. Each project gets a card on the main page. Add a slug to create a full detail page with narrative blocks.
engineer.projTipBody: Add 2-5 of your strongest projects. Include a cover image for visual impact. Projects with a slug get their own dedicated page with images, specs, and challenge/solution narratives.
engineer.projDescPlaceholder: Designed and built an automated irrigation system using soil moisture sensors, Arduino, and a Raspberry Pi controller...
engineer.projDescHint: Shown on the project card. 1-3 sentences.
engineer.projTechPlaceholder: Arduino, Raspberry Pi, Python, SolidWorks, MATLAB
engineer.projCoverHint: Direct image URL for the project card. 16:10 aspect ratio recommended.
engineer.projTaglinePlaceholder: IoT-based precision agriculture for arid climates
engineer.projTaglineHint: Subtitle shown on the detail page
engineer.projBlocksIntro: Build the project detail page as a narrative. Add text, images, specs tables, and challenge/solution sections.
engineer.projParagraphPlaceholder: Describe this part of the project...
engineer.projImageGridHint: Add images as comma-separated URLs (caption after |)
engineer.bgIntro: Optional sections — all auto-hide when empty. Fill in what applies to you. Your projects are the star; this adds professional context.
engineer.bgExpTipBody: Most recent first. Focus on engineering scope, not job duties.
engineer.bgExpDescPlaceholder: Brief scope: what you engineered, for whom, at what scale...
engineer.bgHighlightsPlaceholder:
Designed 132kV substation layout per IEC standards
Led commissioning of 3 gas turbine units
Reduced maintenance downtime by 22%
engineer.bgHighlightsHint: Start each line with what you did. Add numbers where possible.
engineer.bgSkillsIntro: Group skills by category. Common engineering categories: Technical, Software, Tools & Equipment, Standards & Codes.
engineer.bgSkillsItemsPlaceholder: MATLAB, AutoCAD, SolidWorks, PLC Programming, SCADA
engineer.bgCertsIntro: Professional certifications, licenses, and technical qualifications.
engineer.custColorsIntro: Pick a preset or customize individual colors.
engineer.custSectionsIntro: Uncheck sections you want to hide. Empty sections are auto-hidden anyway.
engineer.bgEndorsementsIntro: Short quotes from managers, colleagues or clients. They appear on your portfolio's Endorsements section and add credibility.
engineer.bgEndQuotePlaceholder: Abdulrahman consistently delivers complex projects on schedule and within budget...

creative.profileIntro: The headline of your portfolio. Your initials become the monogram — no profile photo needed.
creative.fullNameHint: Shown large in the hero and as your monogram
creative.title: Title / Discipline
creative.taglineHint: A short line under your name. Shown in the accent color.
creative.websiteHint: Behance, Dribbble, or your own site
creative.resumeUrlHint: A downloadable resume or CV. Shown as a link visitors can open.
creative.bioPlaceholder: A few sentences about your practice, themes, and what drives your work...
creative.bioHint: Shown in the hero, beside your monogram. Keep it evocative and concise.
bioWritingTips: Open with your medium and the themes you explore
Name what makes your perspective distinct
Mention notable shows, collections, or recognition if relevant
Keep it to 2-3 sentences — let the work speak

bioTemplates.label: Practice-led
bioTemplates.text: I work across [mediums] to explore [themes]. My practice is rooted in [place/idea], translating [subject] into [form]. Recent work has been shown at [venues].

bioTemplates.label: Emerging artist
bioTemplates.text: [Discipline] based in [city], working primarily in [medium]. My work investigates [theme], drawing on [influence]. I am currently developing [project/series].

creative.galleryIntro: Each piece becomes a card in the rotating 3D cone and the gallery grid. The cover image is what visitors see first. Open Detail page to build a full case study with images, videos, and text — perfect for projects, UI/UX work, photography series, or live sites.
creative.galleryTip: Use a direct image URL for each cover (portrait / 3:4 looks best in the cone). Add a slug to unlock the detail page, where you can embed videos (YouTube, Vimeo, or .mp4), image galleries, and link out to the live site or app.
creative.galleryItemTitleHint: Shown on the card and as the page heading
creative.galleryCoverUrlHint: Direct link to the image. Portrait (3:4) looks best.
creative.galleryLinkHint: Tapping the card opens this — the video, live ad, campaign or post. Leave blank for no link.
creative.galleryDescriptionPlaceholder: A brand system and responsive site for a Gulf coffee roaster...
creative.galleryDescriptionHint: One or two lines. Shown on the detail page.
creative.galleryToolsPlaceholder: Figma, Photoshop, Oil on canvas, Next.js
creative.galleryToolsHint: Comma-separated. Shown as tags on the detail page.
creative.galleryDetailHint: Add a slug to give this piece its own page with a zoomable cover, content blocks, and links. Leave the slug empty to keep it as a card only.
creative.galleryTaglinePlaceholder: Brand & site for a desert coffee roaster
creative.galleryLinksHint: Live site or app, a video, press coverage, or source code.
creative.galleryBlocksHint: Build the page as a story — text, images, image grids, and embedded videos in any order.
creative.galleryBlockTextPlaceholder: Describe the concept, process, or outcome...
creative.galleryBlockGridHint: One image per line. Add a caption after a | character.
creative.galleryBlockVideoUrlHint: YouTube, Vimeo, or a direct .mp4/.webm link — embedded inline.
creative.aboutSkillsIntro: Grouped into categories. These appear as pills and in the scrolling marquee.
creative.aboutExperienceIntro: Shows, residencies, roles. Listed as a timeline under "Journey".
creative.aboutExpDescriptionPlaceholder: A 30-piece show exploring desert ecology and memory.
creative.aboutAwardsIntro: Show off recognition — awards, certifications, licenses, or honors. Shown in their own section.
creative.aboutMetricsIntro: Optional highlights shown in a scrolling strip (e.g. works, exhibitions, awards).
creative.aboutTestimonialsIntro: What collectors, curators, or clients say about your work. Shown as quoted endorsements.
creative.aboutQuotePlaceholder: Her work transformed our space — bold, intimate, unforgettable.
creative.customizeIntro: The creative template is dark by design. Pick an accent and background, and choose which sections to show.
creative.customizeBackgroundHint: Keep it dark for best contrast
creative.customizeSectionsHint: The hero and contact always show. Empty sections are auto-hidden.

creator.profileIntro: The headline of your portfolio. Your initials become the monogram — no profile photo needed.
creator.fullNameHint: Shown large in the hero and as your monogram
creator.title: Title
creator.titleHint: The small label above your name
creator.taglineHint: The line under your name, in the accent color
creator.introPlaceholder: I turn brands into stories people want to watch — cinematic short-form, vlogs and campaigns across YouTube, Instagram and TikTok.
creator.introHint: One or two sentences about what you make and who it’s for. Shown in the hero.

Name the outcome brands get (reach, engagement, audience)
creator.channelsHint: Each one you add becomes a contact button. Leave blank to hide it.
creator.brandsIntro: Names of brands, clients or collaborators. They scroll in a marquee that signals credibility at a glance. Optional — add as many as you like.
